rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday term for bib overalls with shoulder straps and a chest panel.

example.english: When we work on the farm, wearing overalls is much more convenient.
example.traditional: 做農場嘢嗰陣，著住工人褲方便好多。
example.jyutping: zou6 nung4 coeng4 je5 go2 zan6 zoek3 zyu6 gung1 jan4 fu3 fong1 bin6 hou2 do1

rows.note: Use this for a one-piece protective work garment worn over ordinary clothes rather than for bib-style trousers.

example.english: Before painting, I put on overalls over my ordinary clothes so I don't dirty them.
example.traditional: 油漆之前，我會喺便服外面着連身工作服，免得整污糟啲衫。
example.jyutping: jau4 cat1 zi1 cin4 ngo5 wui5 hai2 bin6 fuk6 ngoi6 min6 zoek6 lin4 san1 gung1 zok3 fuk6 min5 dak1 zing2 wu1 zou1 di1 saam1
